# Golf Ball Drop 2027 · งานทิ้งลูกกอล์ฟการกุศล 2570

> Chiang Mai International Rotary Club (CMIRC). Saturday 30 January 2027, 11:30-16:30, Horizon Village & Resort, 200 Moo 7, Chiang Mai-Doi Saket Road (Highway 118), Choeng Doi, Doi Saket, Chiang Mai 50220.

- A tethered hot-air balloon drops 300 numbered golf balls (1-300) at 15:00. The three balls closest to the X win.
- ฿1,000 a ball online at Ticketmelon (https://www.ticketmelon.com/cmirc/golfballdrop2027, fees shown at checkout), through the order form (https://golfball.nanobotco.workers.dev, 1 ball or 4 for ฿3,000, paid by transfer to the club), or from any club member: ฿1,000 each or 4 for ฿3,000. Winners need not be present.
- Prizes (2026): ฿30,000, ฿10,000 and ฿5,000 in gift vouchers of the winner's choice, valid internationally, not cash.
- On the day: Chiang Mai Expats Club picnic and BBQ from 11:30 (entry paid separately), children's balloon tent 12:00, tethered balloon rides 13:00-15:00 (adults ฿100, children ฿50).
- One ฿1,000 ball pays for 15 hours of survival swimming and water-safety lessons for one child in Chiang Mai or Phrao (the club teaches over 700 children a year), or prescription glasses for two children (the club screens 800 children a year at 14 schools and gives glasses to about 140).
- Money raised goes to the club's current and future children's projects: child safety, health and education in Northern Thailand (https://www.cmirotary.org/).
- Contact: NaN Peacock, fundraising chair, nan@motdang.net, or call +66 94 856 3011
- Page: https://nanobotco.github.io/golf-ball-drop/
